root_cause: The loop condition `for i in range(1, len(S)-1)` prevents the check of the final character in the string. Additionally, identifying the correct index to print is problematic when characters are different, as the current loop and condition may not correctly capture this scenario.
suggestion: Suggestion 1. Adjust the loop range to include the final character. Modify the loop to iterate through the entire string by changing `range(1, len(S)-1)` to `range(1, len(S))`. This will ensure that the last character is also checked against the first character.
